notes: ACCESS: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) storefront reached by DIRECT fetch (curl_cffi via probe.fetch); no proxy needed, exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass recorded. robots.txt names no Anthropic/Claude agent - it only disallows /search*, /cart*, /account*, /checkout* and several Demandware controllers including Search-ShowAjax and Search-UpdateGrid, which I therefore did NOT use. TREE: taken from three independent sources that agree - (1) the homepage mega-menu, server-rendered in full; (2) sitemap_8-category.xml, 840 category URLs; and (3) each PLP's own left-rail Category refinement block (div#refinement-category), which exposes the site's real catalogue hierarchy with parent and child links. QTY: every qty is the PLP's own server-rendered 'N Items' header, which on every page also equals the 'Show N results' control. VERIFICATION: I counted .product-tile elements inside div#product-search-results > div.product-grid, excluding recommendation carousels which do carry data-pid attributes and would over-count, on five furniture leaves - Adirondack Chairs 7=7, Outdoor Sectionals 11=11, Chaise & Daybeds 9=9, Dining Benches 17=17, Outdoor Bar Carts 7=7 - and on Sofas & Loveseats all 58 tiles are server-rendered and 58=58. Counts differ per category with no site-wide constant, no suspiciously round values, every h1 matched the category requested, and each page was fetched twice with identical headers. HIERARCHY DECISIONS: shape/mechanism sub-nodes were dropped and their parent kept as the leaf, because World Market publishes shape and material refinements as indexable facet pages (sitemap-indexable-facets-category-sitemap.xml, 2680 URLs, e.g. .../outdoor-dining-tables/round/, .../metal/, .../teak-wood/). 'Round Coffee Tables' proves the point: its canonical is .../coffee-tables/round/. Affected rows, all flagged: Coffee Tables (Round Coffee Tables 23 dropped), Dining Tables (Round Dining Tables 24 dropped), Chairs (Swivel Chairs 36 dropped). Where children are genuine distinct product types I followed the parent-as-grouping-row rule instead: Benches & Ottomans -> Benches 48 / Ottomans 42 (parent header 139), Bar & Counter Stools -> Backless 5 / With Backs 23 / Counter Stools 68 (parent header 121), Patio Chairs & Seating -> Outdoor Patio Lounge Chairs 44 / Outdoor Chaise Lounge Chairs 14 (parent header 94). In each case the children do not sum to the parent because the parent PLP also carries products filed only at parent level; no number was summed, inferred or copied anywhere. ALIASES / DEDUPE, all resolved by link rel=canonical: /c/furniture/storage-furniture/storage-cabinets-and-shelving%C2%A0/ -> /c/furniture/living-room-furniture/storage-cabinets-and-shelving/ (109); /c/furniture/storage-furniture/bookcases/ -> /c/furniture/home-office-furniture/bookcases/ (43); /c/furniture/entryway-furniture/console-tables/ -> /c/furniture/living-room-furniture/console-tables/ (70); /c/furniture/entryway-furniture/entryway-benches/ -> /c/furniture/living-room-furniture/benches-and-ottomans/benches/ (48); /c/furniture/storage-furniture/bathroom-storage-and-furniture/ -> /c/bath/bathroom-storage%C2%A0and-furniture/ (32); /c/furniture/outdoor-furniture/ -> /c/outdoor/shop-all-outdoor/. Each node is emitted exactly once, at its canonical URL. Because Storage Furniture's only non-alias child is Storage Benches & Ottomans, and Entryway Furniture's two children are both aliases of already-recorded Living Room nodes, Entryway Furniture is recorded as a leaf (90) and flagged. EXCLUDED and why: all 'Shop All ...' pages, New Furniture, New Outdoor, Furniture and Outdoor Best Sellers, and every Sale/Clearance furniture node (section 3). All '...Collections' nodes - Living Room Collections 49, Dining Room Collections 68, Outdoor Furniture Collections & Sets 53, Outdoor Lounge Collections 29, Outdoor Dining Collections 24 - are matching-suite collection pages barred by section 3; the genuine set categories Outdoor Dining Sets 19 and Outdoor Lounge Sets 29 ARE included. Artisan Furniture, Mid Century Furniture, Farmhouse Furniture, Mid Century Modern Outdoor Furniture and Sunbrella Outdoor Furniture & Accessories are style/material landing pages: they appear in the mega-menu and the category sitemap but NOT in the site's own div#refinement-category catalogue tree, which is the objective discriminator I used. Fireplaces & Accessories (30) excluded - its h1 is 'Electric Fireplaces & Accessories' and the tiles are electric fireplace units, fireplace mantels and fireplace screens, i.e. heating appliances and accessories, not furniture. Outdoor Fire Pits, Patio Umbrellas & Stands, Patio Furniture Covers, Outdoor Furniture Care and Replacement Cushions & Slipcovers excluded as not furniture or as furniture care/parts. Bathroom Baskets excluded as standalone storage goods; its canonical is /c/decor-and-pillows/baskets/ (49), i.e. it is the site-wide Baskets node, which also explains why it is larger than its 32-item bathroom parent. Outdoor Pillows & Cushions, Outdoor Rugs, Doormats, Outdoor Lighting, Outdoor Planters & Garden Tools, Outdoor Grilling and the whole Outdoor Kitchen & Dining Entertaining branch excluded as textiles, decor, lighting or kitchen. /c/accent-tables/ excluded - an orphan SEO URL whose canonical is /c/sale/ and whose h1 is 'Sale'. NOT PRESENT: World Market has no kids or nursery furniture department (zero crib/nursery/toddler/kids-furniture slugs across the 840-URL category sitemap), no mattresses, no bathroom vanity units, and no papasan chair category (papasan appears only as cushions under Decor and on two expired Black Friday / Cyber Monday pages).
